description: This file defines the NoteSoap class, which provides SOAP-based web service methods for handling file uploads and retrievals related to Notes in the SuiteCRM system. It includes functionalities to save, retrieve, and process files associated with Note entities, utilizing upload file management and interacting with note beans.

classes.name: NoteSoap
classes.description: Provides SOAP web service methods for managing files related to notes, including saving and retrieving note attachments.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves a file attachment to a note, handling base64 decoding, file extension validation, and saving the file data.

methods.name: newSaveFile
methods.description: New variant of saving a note file, with additional handling for related modules and contact associations.

methods.name: retrieveFile
methods.description: Retrieves a file associated with a note as a base64-encoded string.
